country.text: Which country is your family connection to?
country.help: If your family history touches both, choose the one you know most about. We will look at both routes either way.

relative.text: Who in your family left Germany or Austria?
relative.help: Choose the closest relative to you.

when.help: An approximate decade is enough at this stage.

persecution.text: Was their departure connected to persecution?
persecution.help: This includes fleeing, forced emigration, deportation, or losing citizenship.

records.text: Which family records do you already have?
records.help: Nothing is required now. This tells us how much research your case will need.

residence.help: Your country of residence determines which consulate handles the final step.
